name: io.github.Lyellr88/marm-mcp-server
description: Universal MCP Server with advanced AI memory capabilities and semantic search.
author: Ryan Lyell - marm-memory

tools.name: marm_log_entry
tools.description: Log important information to MARM's memory system

tools.name: marm_smart_recall
tools.description: Hybrid memory recall with bounded concept and linked-code context when available

tools.name: marm_summary
tools.description: Generate intelligent summaries from memory data

tools.name: marm_notebook
tools.description: Unified notebook — add, use, show, status, clear, or save entries (action parameter required)

tools.name: marm_delete
tools.description: Delete a log session, log entry, or notebook entry (type='log'|'notebook')

tools.name: marm_compaction
tools.description: Review, stage, apply, or discard agent-assisted memory compaction candidates

tools.name: marm_graph_index
tools.description: Index a repository into the bundled code graph, check index status, or list indexed projects

tools.name: marm_code_lookup
tools.description: Find symbols, source snippets, or text matches in an indexed repository

tools.name: marm_graph_trace
tools.description: Trace call paths or data flow through the indexed code graph

tools.name: marm_graph_architecture
tools.description: Return high-level architecture, node and edge summaries, modules, and graph schema

tools.name: marm_graph_impact
tools.description: Estimate change impact from git diff context and affected graph symbols

tools.name: marm_concept_build
tools.description: Extract entities and typed relationships from stored memories into the concept graph

tools.name: marm_concept_recall
tools.description: Explicitly query platform-aware concept entities, relationships, and linked code symbols

RECALL_SCAN_LIMIT.description: Maximum embedded memories semantic recall scans per query before reporting recall_scan_truncated=true
